title: Will Broadcom Be Worth More Than Apple by 2040?
snippet:
Analysts expect Broadcom's revenue and adjusted EPS to grow 41% and 11%, respectively, in fiscal 2024 as it integrates VMware, it sells more AI-oriented chips, and the macro environment improves. In fiscal 2025, analysts forecast its revenue and adjusted EPS to rise 14% and 22%, respectively, as it fully laps its acquisition of VMware. [...] Motley Fool

# Will Broadcom Be Worth More Than Apple by 2040?

Leo Sun, The Motley Fool

4 min read

 AVGO

  +0.32%
 AAPL

  +1.75%

Broadcom's (NASDAQ: AVGO) stock has soared about 1,900% over the past 10 years. The chipmaker, which was known as Avago until it bought the original Broadcom in 2016, impressed investors with its robust growth and bold acquisitions. [...] From fiscal 2016 to fiscal 2023, Broadcom's adjusted revenue rose at a compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of 15%, its adjusted gross margin expanded from 60.5% to 74.7%, and its adjusted earnings per share (EPS) increased at a CAGR of 21%.
